title: Version & Support
subtitle: Application version information and where to get help.

blocks.text: This documentation corresponds to TaraHive version 1.1.0. New releases may introduce additional features, improvements, or interface changes.
If you encounter issues or have questions, visit the Help section within the application or contact the TaraHive support team through the official support channels.
Keeping TaraHive updated ensures you receive the latest features, performance improvements, and security updates.
